name: OpsLevel
description:
OpsLevel provides a managed endpoint that exposes your catalog, standards, and actions to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol. Any MCP-compatible agent can connect to it and query your OpsLevel data.
MCP server only uses read-only access to your OpsLevel account and can read data from resources like Actions, Campaigns, Checks, Components, Teams, Users etc

_published_faq.name: How do I add OpsLevel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OpsLevel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.opslevel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OpsLevel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpsLevel lists 17 MCP tools, including account_metadata, componentDependencies, componentDependents, get_opslevel_resource, list_campaigns, list_checks, list_components, list_documents, list_documents_on_component, list_domains, list_filters, and list_infrastructure_resources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OpsLevel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OpsLevel in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
OpsLevel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OpsLevel is developed by Opslevel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
